summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC. filed a Form 6-K announcing its participation in the Cathay Securities 2026 Q2 Industry Forum, where management will present recent financial results and business trends. This is an routine investor relations event, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing serves solely as a notice of an upcoming investor presentation.
